name: FastAPI
purpose: FastAPI solves the problem of building fast, robust, and production-ready APIs with Python. It matters because it enables developers to create high-performance web services with significantly reduced development time and fewer bugs, making it ideal for scalable backend systems and microservices.
coreComponents: Starlette (underlying ASGI framework for performance and async capabilities)
Pydantic (for data validation, serialization, and automatic API documentation)
Dependency Injection System (for managing shared logic, database connections, and security)
APIRouter (for structuring scalable projects with modular endpoints)
keyCapabilities: Automatic interactive API documentation (Swagger UI and ReDoc)
Data validation and serialization using Python type hints and Pydantic
Asynchronous support (`async`/`await`) for high performance and concurrent requests
Dependency Injection system for modular and testable code
Built-in security features (OAuth2, JWT, API Key validation)
integrations: SQL and NoSQL Databases (e.g., SQLAlchemy, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB)
Cloud Platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure, Docker for containerization)
Authentication Services (e.g., AWS Cognito, Auth0, Firebase Authentication, OAuth2, JWT)
Monitoring and Logging Tools (e.g., structlog, Apitally, ASGI Correlation ID)
Frontend Frameworks (e.g., Jinja2 + HTMX for UI)
useCases: Building AI and Machine Learning APIs
Creating Real-time Backend Systems and IoT deployments
Data processing and internal automation tools
SaaS application backends and API-first products
